name: 3D
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and can only be played after a successfully played card. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse the card titled Irish Whip or any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: A Victim of the Crippler
Text: Your opponent cannot play Manager or Stipulation cards.

name: Ankle Lock
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Apply Legal Leverage
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card.

name: Arm Breaker
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent discards 1 card in order to play an Action card.

name: Asian Mist
Text: As an action, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if the card titled Roll Out of the Ring is in your Ring area. Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and he discards the chosen cards. As a reversal, when the card titled Roll Out of the Ring is in your Ring area, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. The first card played during your next turn cannot be reversed.

name: Ayatollah of Rock 'n' Roll-a
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. Your next 3 maneuvers played this turn cannot be reversed from his Arsenal, Backlash deck, or Ringside pile.

name: Backed by Mr. McMahon
Text: Can only be played when your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value. At the end of the Pre-match phase, he does 3 of the following: discards 2 cards, overturns 7 cards, skips his first turn, plays with his hand revealed until the second turn of the match, allows you to draw up to 2 cards, or concedes and loses the match.

name: Battling the Voices
Text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your Arsenal, put 3 into your hand, and put the rest into your Ringside pile

name: Blindsided Ego
Text: Can only be played from your Ringside pile and when you have 2 or more cards in your hand. When played from your Ringside pile, reverse any non-unique maneuver or any card with the word 'ego'in the title and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 cards and then remove all Reversal cards that do not have the word 'Blindside'in the title in your Ringside pile from the game.

name: Booker's Scissor Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you played the card titled Spinnerooni to end your opponent's last turn. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Buh-Buh Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed when the card titled Table! Table! Table! is in your Ring area. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Buh-Buh Ray Dudley
Text: During your Draw Segment, instead of drawing 1 card, you may draw # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards in your and your opponent's Ring areas -2, and then discard your hand at the end of your turn unless you successfully played the card titled Catatonic Stare, Dudley Tough, or My Name Is... that turn. When the card titled Beatings from Dudleyville is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 1 card and then put that card into your hand. When you successfully play the card titled Brothers from Another Mother, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Brotherly Love.

name: Bulldog Takedown
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand and Arsenal.

name: Caped Body Press
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card.

name: Chain Lashing
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars. Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played, your opponent randomly discards 2 cards from his Backlash deck.

name: Charismatic Style
Text: Put 1 non-unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Chop to the Chest
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +3D and your opponent's Reversal card to it is +3F.

name: Chris Benoit
Text: The first maneuver you play each turn is +1D, the second +2D, the third +3D, and so forth. When you have the card titled A Victim of the Crippler in your Ring area, double those modifiers. Your card titled Benoit's German Suplex is -6F. Your card titled P

name: Christian's Shades
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Comeback!
Text: Discard 1 card. The player with the highest Fortitude Rating puts Maneuver cards and Reversal cards from his Ring area into his Ringside pile until his Fortitude Rating is not highest.

name: Corkscrew DDT
Text: As a reversal, this card is -7F, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn.

name: DDT
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Dem Damn Dudleyz!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Did I Just Say ... Three Minutes?
Text: Remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. When you have a card in your Ring area with the Raw logo, this card is not Active.

name: Diversion
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Do You Know What My Watch Says?
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. When played by Stone Cold Steve Austin, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1 and your Superstar Ability now reads as 'During your Draw Segment, draw 1 additional card.' When played by The Rattlesnake, your Starting Hand Size is +2.

name: Doin' the D-Von
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Maneuver card, reveal it to him, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Don't Cross the Boss
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent successfully plays an Action card, you may draw a card.

name: Drawing Extra Heat
Text: Draw 1 card and then your opponent discards 1 card and overturns 2 cards.

name: DTA
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled The Bionic Redneck is in your Ring area. Look at your opponent's hand and then shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Dude, Nice Hang Time!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When your next card played this turn is a High Risk maneuver, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text and it cannot be reversed from his hand or Backlash deck.

name: Eddie's Roll Up
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a card from your hand to end your opponent's last turn. Cannot be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck. When successfully played, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand than your opponent, you win the game via Pinfall victory.

name: Edge's Spear
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed when played after the card titled From the Top Rope. As a reversal, reverse any card played after the card titled Irish Whip or any other Set-up card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Enough With the Trash Talk
Text: As an action, remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game. As a reversal, this card is -8F, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to draw any number of cards or search his Arsenal for any number of cards and end his turn.

name: Extreme Monkey Flip
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and he discards the chosen cards. If the card titled Chair Shot or Ladder in the Ring is in any Ring area, instead choose up to 4 cards.

name: Facebuster
Text: Reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip or any other Set-up card and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Faceplant
Text: As a reversal, this card is -9D, reverse any non-unique card that would cause you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn.

name: First to Tap Out Match
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. When any player successfully plays the card titled Maintain Hold after a maneuver of 8D or greater, he wins via Pinfall victory. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then put the card titled Maintain Hold from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Five Star Frog Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, or if this is your first card played this turn and you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Freaks Are Cool!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your non-unique maneuvers are -#F, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: Garbage Can Lid
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Get Him, Boyz!
Text: You cannot pack this card when you are packing the card titled Good Golly, Miss Molly Holly. Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Get Ready ... Your Candy Ass is Next!
Text: Draw 1 card. Your next card played this turn can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Get Your GED
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Study for Your GED is in your Ring area. Shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw up to 3 cards.

name: Goodwill Ambassador
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Great Technical Knowledge
Text: Draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are +1D.

name: Greetings from Dudleyville, U.S.A.
Logos: D-Von Dudley, Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +2. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 5 or greater, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 10 or greater, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Gut Punch
Text: When successfully played, discard any number of cards and then put the same number of non-Maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When your next card played this turn is the card titled 360-Degree Clothesline, it cannot be reversed.

name: Happy You're Here, Happier You're Gone
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever your opponent discards a card for your Superstar Ability or his Superstar Ability, he discards an additional card.

name: Hardcore Style
Text: When this card is going to your Ringside pile, instead put it into your Backlash deck. Can only be played when there is a Feud or Venue card in any Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, your Foreign Object maneuvers are +2D and your other maneuvers are +1D.

name: Hellfire Chokeslam
Text: As a reversal, reverse the card titled Back Body Drop or any card with the word 'slam'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: Help's On the Way!
Logos: Kane, Road Dogg, X-Pac, Billy Gunn
Text: You cannot pack this card when you are packing the card titled Tori Enters the Fray! Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: I Am the Game
Text: Cannot be reversed by hybrid Reversal cards. Draw 2 cards and your opponent discards 2 cards. Your maneuvers are +3D for the rest of the turn.

name: I'm Better Than You!
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent, you may draw 1 card.

name: I'm the Biggest Dog on this Block!
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.'

name: Immune to Pain
Text: When this card is going to your Ringside pile, instead put it into your Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers are -1D.

name: Iron Will
Text: As an action, discard this card, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal that are not titled Iron Will, and your opponent discards 1 card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Japanese Buzzsaw
Text: Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: Jerichoholics
Text: Draw 1 card. Your opponent discards 3 cards when you have the card titled The Breakdown in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, if your opponent causes you to discard any number of cards, you may put this card into your hand instead of discarding.

name: Judo Choke
Text: When this card is in your hand, and your opponent successfully plays an Action that is not their first Action played this turn, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, once during each of your turns when you have no other Ring Judo Choke cards, they overturn 1 card.

name: Just Who in the Blue Hell Do You Think You Are?
Text: When played by The Rock, the maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1 and the maximum number of Mid-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 3. When played by The People's Champion, your Starting Hand Size is +2.

name: Kane's Flying Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver.

name: Kick
Text: Cannot be packed by Female Superstars.

name: Knife-Edge Chop
Text: When played after the card titled Irish Whip, can only be reversed by unique Reversal cards or Reversal cards that specifically reverse a maneuver if that maneuver is played after the card titled Irish Whip. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: Kurt Angle
Text: You can pack both Face and Heel cards. Your Starting Hand Size is +1 for every Superstar-specific Pre-match card in your Ring area.

name: Ladder in the Ring
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may discard 1 card and then your next High Risk maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Leader of the Edge Army
Text: When your opponent successfully plays an Action card, draw 1 card and he discards 1 card. You may pack any cards with the Edge logo, but you do not count as Edge.

name: Lita's DDT
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Lou Thesz Press
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip or a successfully played 5D or greater Strike maneuver. As a reversal, this card is -5F, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Maintain Hold
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played non-Restricted-Modification-Symbol Submission maneuver. End your turn. The maintained maneuver is not considered a Multi maneuver. You and your opponent cannot play any cards that do not reverse the maintained maneuver until it is reversed. Once during each of your turns, the maintained maneuver does its damage along with any effects. If the maintained maneuver is reversed, it is no longer considered maintained.

name: Managed by Kyo Dai
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 card that does not have the Tag Team Symbol from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'kick'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Managed by Vince McMahon
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, choose 2 of the following: blank the text of a Stipulation card in your opponent's Ring area, put a Title Belt from his Ring area into his Ringside pile, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand, or increase the number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area by 2.

name: Matt's Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver.

name: My Name Is...
Text: Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: My Path is Chosen
Text: Search your Arsenal for 2 non-unique cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: No Chance in Hell!
Text: This card is -6F for every card titled Don't Cross the Boss in your Ring area or Ringside pile. Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Put any number cards titled Don't Cross the Boss from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: No Disqualification Match
Text: Your Foreign Object cards and Run-in cards are -3F.

name: Offer Handshake
Text: Draw up to 4 cards and then your opponent may draw 1 card.

name: Patented Rock Footstomp
Text: This card is +1D for every Superstar-specific card in your Ring area. When successfully played, draw up to 2 cards or shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Puppies! Puppies!
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent is a Female Superstar. Shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards.

name: Put It All On the Line
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if you successfully play a High Risk maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside pile and shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Rabid Attack in the Corner
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and it cannot be reversed.

name: Rabid Wolverine
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your turn ends, you may discard 1 card and continue your turn.

name: Remove the People's Elbow Pad
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is your first card played this turn. Your opponent cannot play Reversal cards from his hand for the rest of the turn. When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, you may overturn 1 card and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: Revolving Takedown
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F, +2D, and can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. As a reversal, reverse any card with the word 'takedown'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: Ric Flair Interferes
Text: You cannot pack this card when you are packing the card titled Chyna Interferes or Stephanie Interferes. Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Rock Bottom
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Sharpshooter
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and you may put 1 card from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Single Arm DDT
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for 1 card with the word 'DDT'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: SmackDown! #1 Announcer Funaki
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 3 cards and then put 3 cards in your hand on the top or the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Spine Buster
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F and your opponent discards 1 card. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Spinning Elbow
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Springboard
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. If your next card played this turn is a Strike maneuver, it is instead considered a High Risk maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: Springboard Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver or the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Steel Chain Shot
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any Unique card and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if you successfully play a Unique card, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Strangle Hold
Text: As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any Submission maneuver (including the card titled Clutch onto Opponent) and end your opponent's turn.

name: Stratusfaction Bulldog
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed by the card titled Elbow to the Face. Search your Arsenal for 1 Action card or 1 card with the word 'bulldog'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Summer of Slam
Logos: Hulk Hogan, Ric Flair, Hall and Nash, Trish Stratus, Tajiri, Hurricane, Al Snow, Billy and Chuck
Text: Your opponent randomly discards 2 cards from his Backlash deck.

name: Superior Leg Work
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a maneuver, draw 1 card or your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Superplex
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 8D or greater maneuver or the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand by the card titled Hold the Phone! or Superplex, otherwise, can only be reversed from his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Superplex or any maneuver played after the card titled From the Tope Rope or From the Middle Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn.

name: Suplex into the Ring
Text: As an action, discard this card and you may put 1 non-unique Maneuver card or 2 Maneuver cards with the word 'suplex'in the title from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn. He overturns 2 cards. When successfully played, you may choose 1 different Enforcer for you or your opponent.

name: Table! Table! Table!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or the card titled Roll Out of the Ring. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card in your Ringside pile and your next Grapple maneuver played this turn is +10D and +2 Stun Value and your opponent's Reversal cards to that maneuver are +4D.

name: Tajiri's Handspring Elbow
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Set-up card and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, put 1 non-unique card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Tarantula
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Testify!
Text: Put up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand and your opponent skips his next turn.

name: The Dirtiest Player in the Game
Text: Reverse any High Risk maneuver or Mid-match card and end your opponent's turn. Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards with the word 'chop'in the title or titled Apply Illegal Leverage, reveal them to him, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: The Flair Flop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver of 4D or greater. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of the turn, overturn cards until it is reversed or until full damage has been applied, and end your opponent's turn. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and put any number of cards titled Over Sell Maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The Game Interferes!
Text: Reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Game Is Back, and The Game is Here to Stay!
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1. Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -3.

name: The Highlight of the Night
Text: Your opponent cannot play more than 1 Action card per turn. You may pack any cards with the Chris Jericho logo, but you do not count as Chris Jericho.

name: The Manbeast
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may discard 4 cards to reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Reduce the number of cards discarded by 1 for every 2 Stun Value in your Ring area. The number of cards discarded cannot go below 2.

name: The West Coast Pop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 6D or greater maneuver or if you reversed a card from your hand to end your opponent's last turn and this is your first card played this turn. When successfully played, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand than him, you win the game via Pinfall victory.

name: Thou Shall Not #### With the Dudleyz!
Text: Reverse any card that would cause you to discard any number of cards and end your opponent's turn. He discards 3 cards.

name: TLC Match
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Edge and Christian, Hardy Boyz
Text: All players search their Arsenal for any number of cards titled Table! Table! Table, Ladder in the Ring, and Chair Shot, reveal them to their opponent, put them into their Backlash deck, and shuffle their Arsenal. These cards are now played as Mid-match cards, but do not count as such outside of your Backlash deck. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 1 card and then put 1 card titled Table! Table! Table, Ladder in the Ring, or Chair Shot from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: To the Hurricycle!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Underrated Superstar
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, when your Superstar Value is 2 or less, draw 3 cards. If you are not the player with the lowest Superstar Value, discard 1 card.

name: Undertaker's Flying Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver.

name: Version 1.0
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +1. Your Superstar Ability now reads as 'When you successfully play a Grapple or High Risk maneuver, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.'

name: Vertical DDT Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is your first card played this turn.

name: Viva La Raza! Low Rider
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Foreign Object card and 1 Grapple maneuver, reveal them to your opponent, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard a card and then put 1 card from under this card into your hand. When the card titled Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring area, all Grapple and Foreign Object maneuvers are +3D. When this card is moved from your Ring area, put all cards under this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Waist Lock
Text: When successfully played, choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring area, and after damage has been applied, end your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, that card's text is blank.

name: Whassupwitdat?!?!?
Text: Reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: When Hell Freezes Over!
Text: As an action, discard this card and then draw 1 card. As a reversal, when played from your hand or Ringside pile, reverse any card played from your opponent's Ringside pile or any card with the word 'hell'in the title and end his turn. The reversed card is removed from the game.

name: Who Booked This Match?
Text: Draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Who's That Jumpin' Out The Sky?
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card titled From the Top Rope and 1 card titled Springboard, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then draw 1 card.

name: Word Life
Text: Your opponent may discard 3 Reversal cards. If he does not, he discards 5 cards.

name: Wrestling with a Broken Freakin' Neck
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Grapple maneuvers are +2D.

name: Yes, I've Lost My Mind
Text: As an action, your maneuvers can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal for the rest of the turn. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Yo, Ese, I Know You, Homes!
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1. Your cards titled Guerrero Frog Splash and Eddie's Roll Up are -10F. When your opponent is Chris Benoit, Edge, Rob Van Dam, Rey Mysterio, or The People's Champion, your Superstar Ability now reads as 'Each turn, the first two High Risk maneuvers you play cannot be reversed.'

name: You Can't See Me
Text: Look at your opponent's hand and draw 1 card. If he reverses your next maneuver played this turn, he skips his next turn.

name: You Will Respect Me
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, your opponent chooses Action or Reversal and then overturns cards until a card of the chosen type is overturned. That card is removed from the game. Repeat this 2 more times.

name: You're a Human Vacuum Cleaner ... You Suck and Blow at the Same Time
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 3.

name: You're Going to Space Mountain
Text: Remove the top 4 cards of your opponent's Arsenal from the game. The first non-unique non-Reversal card you play of the game is -4F.

name: You're Gonna Pay!
Text: Discard any number of cards from your Backlash deck and then your opponent discards the same number of cards +3 from his Backlash deck.

name: Your Brush with Greatness is Over
Logos: The People's Team, The Rock, Hulk Hogan, Edge
Text: You may put 1 card from your Ring area into your Ringside pile; shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal; and then look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Arsenal and put them back in any order.
